note: Marinette County park beside Timms Lake in NE Marinette County; the campsites sit in the woods roughly 200 m east of the lake, its beach and boat landing. Rock outcroppings, 2.5 miles of hiking trails and an overlook. After October 15 the water tower closes, and an early freeze any time after October 1 can shut the water system, shower building and dump station for the season. --Claude
summary: County reservations page, 2027 fee alert and fee schedule, all 43 site pages, map PDF and imagery read. Fees $30-35 -> $30-45 (50A pull-throughs $45 from 2027); 50A electric, 45 sites, pads to 60 ft, pull-throughs, facilities, season May 1-Nov 30 (manual), booking operator/184 days/reservable only. Lakefront -> not waterfront lead (sites ~200 m from Timms Lake in forest). Pin ~360 m off. Phone missing.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lead: lakefront -> not waterfront. The county map (1 inch = 150 ft) puts every campsite east of the park road with the lodge, beach and boat landing between them and Timms Lake; on imagery the westernmost sites (19-22) are ~200-220 m from the lake's east shore under continuous forest. No site is near the water; no view. The marsh pond north of sites 12-17 is wetland, not a lake.

PIN MOVE ~360 m: stored 45.6688,-87.8929 is on the park road by the lodge near the lake. The campground's loops (sites 1-34 and the 35-45 pull-through loop around the shower building) centre at about 45.6691,-87.8885.

PHONE missing (stored null): give 715-732-7530 (Marinette County Parks Office, named in the campground page's cancellation policy). WEBSITE https://www.marinettecountywi.gov/parks/camping/morgan_park_campground/ confirmed.
Site count: the page says 45 electric campsites; the booking engine lists 43 (no 11 or 33, maybe host sites). Every listed pad is 35 ft+ long, so a 23-ft rig fits all of them.
Real public county campground (online nightly booking, no seasonal leases mentioned). ATV/UTV riding prohibited in this park (county alert). Inclusion evidence current.
